description: Threads and schedulers: every library's worker-thread work goes through one neutral scheduler interface.

provides_scheduler.description: True when the library implements the shared scheduler interface (it fills the jobs slot).

scheduler.description: Who implements the shared interface: the reference thread pool in setup glue, or the library in the jobs slot.

rules.text: Library work that runs on worker threads is submitted through the shared scheduler interface, which observes it during a smoke run.
A ThreadSanitizer build completes a smoke run with no report that has a frame, in either stack, in code the composition builds.
rules.procedure: Separate build directory; -fsanitize=thread for C, C++ and link; Debug; TSAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=0:exitcode=66; run the composition's executable with --probe; parse every 'WARNING: ThreadSanitizer' report; a report counts unless every frame in both stacks is in code the composition doesn't build, in which case it is recorded under set_aside_reports.

seeded_violation.description: Add an unsynchronized counter that the reference thread pool's workers increment each time round their loop, before taking the lock, and submit() increments too.

rules.text: A library must not block a worker thread waiting on work only that worker could run.
